$comment: Jev semantic-tier configuration — the question catalog for the AI-based control tier. Lives at the project root as policy.jev.json, separate from the policy engine's policy.json: this file defines WHAT the decision model is asked (binary yes/no checks, wording, per-check thresholds) plus the deadline, decisiveness floor and egress cap; policy.json keeps only what the policy engine owns (which profile applies, and how evidence maps to verdicts). Binary checks only — each entry is one yes/no question, and the whole enabled set is evaluated in a single decide() round trip. `groups` maps each user group id to the check ids that apply to it. Every check is currently available to every group; drop an id from a group to restrict it.
